metadata.description: Skills to set up, audit and evolve a repository's AI instrumentation, and to tool a team's development cycle.

plugins.name: harness-ai
plugins.description: Claude Code skills to set up, audit and evolve a repository's AI instrumentation, one step at a time, and to write a team's path from ticket to production down and check it on paper.

plugins.name: ai-sdlc
plugins.description: The phases of the development cycle assisted by an agent, from ticket to production: a shared base that each team completes in its repository. Available phases: ticket, dev, qa, secu, review, ship and run.

plugins.name: harness-hud
plugins.description: A heads-up display for a repository set up with harness-ai: one quiet row above the prompt and a pane with the level ladder, read from .harness/state.json. Reads only, runs nothing.
